scope: Encoded: who is insured under Chapters 5, 6, 7 (s 158 (1)-(3), with s 6B), 8, 9, 10 and 11, on a day, from facts, with Schedule A1 Parts A, B, C, E and s 1 'retirement age'; s 2A (who is not an Israeli resident) and the residence words of s 65; s 238 housewife, widow, widow pensioner; ss 69, 69A, 71; s 381 and the Rounding Regulations 5746-1985; the updating clause of s 1 for the child allowance, 2015-2026, over the CBS index; the Family Allowance Regulations regs 1 and 11; the gates of the Income Support Law (ss 2-4, 5(b), 7(b), 8, 14(a), 14A(a)) and the Maintenance Law (ss 1, 2, 3, 6(a), 9, 9A); an adapter from the derived statuses to row IL-08's s 335. Inputs: the positive test of residence, the visa facts, temporary resident, the regulations' classes under ss 75 and 243, the pension facts behind the widow pensioner, the Income Support Law's income and rates, the Maintenance Law's rates. Out of scope with reasons: NOTES.md section 2. From 0.1.1 the retirement age of a woman born in 1956 or later is the Retirement Age Law's, through row IL-27's module.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source. No independent test pass has been run on it yet. Every expected value in the tests was worked by hand from the Hebrew before the run, by the same session that wrote the rules.
